title.en: Find the IGMP messages in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and show only IGMP: queries, reports, joins and leaves.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur sirf IGMP dikhao: queries, reports, joins aur leaves.

expect.en: Membership Reports to 224.0.0.22, General Queries to 224.0.0.1 every 125 s, and group-specific queries after a leave. All have TTL 1.
expect.hinglish: 224.0.0.22 ko Membership Reports, har 125 s 224.0.0.1 ko General Queries, aur leave ke baad group-specific queries. Sabka TTL 1 hota hai.

why.en: Filter the multicast video stream sent to group 239.1.1.5.
why.hinglish: Group 239.1.1.5 ko bheji gayi multicast video stream filter karo.

expect.en: UDP packets to port 5000 carrying RTP with MPEG-TS, destination MAC 01:00:5e:01:01:05, appearing only while someone is joined.
expect.hinglish: Port 5000 par UDP packets jo MPEG-TS ke saath RTP carry karte hain, destination MAC 01:00:5e:01:01:05, jo sirf tab dikhte hain jab koi joined ho.

title.en: See which multicast groups your own PC has joined
title.hinglish: Dekho tumhare apne PC ne kaunse multicast groups join kiye hain

why.en: Read-only list of multicast group memberships on your machine; they are the groups IGMP reports for you.
why.hinglish: Tumhari machine par multicast group memberships ki read-only list; yeh wahi groups hain jinke liye IGMP tumhari taraf se report karta hai.

expect.en: You will usually see 224.0.0.1 (all hosts) and 224.0.0.251 (mDNS), maybe 239.255.255.250 (SSDP). Output varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Aam taur par 224.0.0.1 (all hosts) aur 224.0.0.251 (mDNS) dikhega, shayad 239.255.255.250 (SSDP) bhi. Output machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

why.en: IGMP packets carry the IP Router Alert option so routers look at them.
why.hinglish: IGMP packets IP Router Alert option carry karte hain taaki routers unhe dekhein.

expect.en: Matches IGMP packets that include the 4-byte option 94 04 00 00 in the IP header.
expect.hinglish: Un IGMP packets se match karta hai jinke IP header mein 4-byte option 94 04 00 00 hai.
